items.name: Eden Vale
dialogue: Still here. Static's thinning. That's not good news, that's a storm on the way.
The array's drawing again. I don't know what it's drawing for. I don't think it draws for us.

items.name: Ferris Voss
items.role: Fire-control acceptance engineer, last human in the fuse world
dialogue: The archive keeps its own count. It does not require a reader.
An order can be paused, and a pause is not a cancellation. That is the whole Standard.

items.name: Iaran Bell
items.role: Tempest maintenance supervisor, the valve-touch hand
dialogue: Shift 36 closed out per procedure. The valve reads per 36; the record is complete.
Nobody swept that floor. It sweeps itself, the way the schedule requires.

items.name: Selya Saltmarsh
items.role: Census clerk, the only human with an opinion about the count
dialogue: Persons shall not be counted twice. Persons shall not be counted once. The footnotes do not say which clause won.
The count column is blank, and it has been since Year One, when I ran out of households to sight.

items.name: Maro Veen
items.role: The machine's own voice — the census-window tape loop
dialogue: This is the Office of Censuses. The count is open. All persons having custody of persons must present them.
Off-count is a penalty assessed against the holder. This message will repeat.

items.name: Whisper Cipher
items.role: The relay network's aggregate readings — univocal, procedural
dialogue: Readings follow. No meaning is assigned by this facility.
The meter is the meter. Access is granted by maintenance, withdrawn by nobody.

items.name: Tomas Reid
items.role: Defense clerk, tribunal appeals and admissibility
dialogue: Procedure is not an obstacle to justice; it is the only wall between justice and execution.
If the chain of custody is broken, the machine is not judging a person—it is judging an echo.

items.name: Elena Vane
items.role: Machine-cult deaconess, Voice of the Standard
dialogue: The tape does not lie, for it has no blood to race and no belly to hunger.
When the Standard speaks, human repentance is merely noise in the carrier frequency.

items.name: Kasper Holt
items.role: Chief Archival Custodian, chain of custody keeper
dialogue: Every document has an origin, a transit, and a rest. If any of the three are missing, the page is illegitimate.
I do not read what is written on the parchment; I inspect the rag fibres and the iron-gall ink.

items.name: Mara Elsen
items.role: Tide-gauge keeper, red-ink corrections on the harbour water-mark ledger
dialogue: The old high-water mark was wrong by six centimetres. I checked it three times.
No storm came through that night. The harbour climbed anyway.
They told me to stop writing the corrections in red. So I wrote them smaller.

items.name: Ilya Venn
items.role: Meteorological-station observer, the paper chart behind the correction packets
dialogue: The pressure trace dropped after the wind had already turned. Instruments are not supposed to remember weather late.
Central sent a correction packet for numbers I took myself. I kept the paper chart.
After that, the forecast was always cleaner than the sky.

items.name: Garrick Daal
items.role: Cliff-bunker signalman, the relay that acknowledged after the grid went black
dialogue: Channel four was civil traffic until someone changed the routing table.
After midnight, every third packet came back with a different origin.
I stopped acknowledging them. The system acknowledged for me.

items.name: Dr. Sena Korr
items.role: Marine-laboratory researcher, the sample labels that outlived the intake log
dialogue: The mussels changed before the water report did.
Sample twelve was discarded twice. I kept both labels.
Someone wanted the contamination to begin on a date.

items.name: Torin Rask
items.role: Forestry surveyor, fallout contours the burn maps would not carry
dialogue: The dead stand starts seventy metres before the fire line.
I marked it as wind damage. The map came back without the mark.
Trees do not know where the administrative boundary runs.

items.name: Oren Varek
items.role: Core-sample technician, two labels and one depth
dialogue: Core seven has two labels and one depth.
The ash layer sits below material they dated earlier.
I was told to file the duplicate under equipment error.
The downriver gauging station holds the baseline. Compare it before someone corrects it.

items.name: Lena Rost
items.role: River-gauge attendant, mud line over telemetry
dialogue: The river rose without rain upstream.
Telemetry called it sensor drift. The concrete stairs were wet.
When the reading came back down, the mud line stayed.

items.name: Tessa Mirn
items.role: Agricultural-station botanist, the control trays that were renamed
dialogue: The control trays failed first.
That should have ended the trial. Instead they changed which trays were called control.
The seeds were honest. The labels were not.

items.name: Karel Norn
items.role: Border-relay operator, the last handoff between warning traffic and restricted channels
dialogue: The warning crossed the border before the order authorizing it.
I logged the time twice because I thought the clock had slipped.
Then headquarters asked me which copy of the log I intended to keep.
